title: Leverage Defaults
hook: The things you do without thinking shape your week way more than the things you plan.
statement: Default behavior beats chosen behavior over time.
explainer: Every decision costs a little energy. A good default makes the choice once and keeps paying off for months, with zero effort from you.
sop: Write what your ideal week looks like with zero active decisions.
Score your current Default 1 to 10 for one area, like meals or follow-ups.
Pre-decide it with a template, standing appointment, or auto-rule.
Remove the manual choice completely, don't just make it easier.
Let it run untouched for a month before tweaking.
equation_example: Default quality 8, running for Time of 12 weeks. 8 × 12 = 96. Higher means a good default stacks up a strong result on autopilot. A low Default means every week on autopilot is working against you.
question: Pick one daily decision and set it up this week so you never have to make it again.
closing_statement: What happens automatically matters more than what you choose.
caption:
Principle Nº 114: Leverage Defaults

The things you do without thinking shape your week way more than the things you plan.

Default behavior beats chosen behavior over time.

Your turn: Pick one daily decision and set it up this week so you never have to make it again.
